<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="_T8RISXAtjoIoJcondKn"> <mxGraphModel dx="3084" dy="1822" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1700" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 participant L as Listener
 participant I as Icecast
 participant B as Backend<br/>Go
 participant O as Ollama<br/>AI Agents
 participant T as Chatterbox<br/>TTS
 participant Lq as Liquidsoap
 participant DB as SQLite
 
 L->>I: Stream Playing Song
 I-->>L: MP3 Audio
 B->>B: Wait 45s before end
 B->>DB: getCandidates()
 DB-->>B: Similar Songs List
 B->>O: Director Prompt
 Note over O: Pick next song<br/>based on BPM/mood
 O-->>B: Selected Track Path
 B->>O: DJ Prompt
 Note over O: Write intro text<br/>for next song
 O-->>B: DJ Voiceover Text
 B->>T: generateVoice()
 Note over T: Synthesize WAV<br/>with TTS
 T-->>B: WAV File
 B->>Lq: QUEUE next_song.mp3
 B->>Lq: PLAY duke_voice.wav
 Lq->>Lq: Duck music<br/>Play voice<br/>Crossfade to next
 Lq-->>I: Continuous Stream
 I-->>L: Seamless Transition
 B->>DB: logPlayHistory()",
 "config": null
